honesty.coins: Play coins - not money: never exchangeable, never bought, never linked to payments.
honesty.lots: Lots, shops and rentals are AUTHORED game lots on the AUTHORED map fabric - not real properties, addresses, listings or businesses.
honesty.state: State stays in this browser (localStorage); no account, no server, no network.
honesty.games: City life is play: it never enters a completion record and certifies nothing.

placement.rule: grid 200 m around each parish LOCAL origin (nearest first, within 32000 m), inside the RECORDED outline, outside the water keep-out, min gap 240 m, up to 5 lots per zone
placement.landuse_method: DERIVED: 9x9 pixel window of PARISH AUTHORED ground tile matched to parishes/render.py USE tints (tol 4, margin 3); >= 15% one zone and the other zone <= 1/5 of it

water_keepout.note: approximate; inland water is not cut out of the outlines, this is not a shoreline

placement.frame: parish LOCAL metres (PARISH contract); x = east_m, z = -north_m

coin_rules.what: AUTHORED game-balance values for play; never exchangeable, never bought, never linked to payments.
